subject.title: fix(ai): guard payload-less media blocks from erasing tool-result text

question: Should the repository keep this focused PR as the landing candidate, or consolidate the work into the broader maintainer-owned https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795?
rationale: Both branches change the same provider replay invariant, but the broader draft also changes the owning fresh-result boundary and already has stronger tests and live proof; automation should not choose between overlapping maintainer and contributor branches.

options.title: Consolidate into the broader PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795 as the canonical branch and preserve any useful focused cases from this PR there.

options.title: Keep this focused PR
options.body: Require provider-specific regressions and redacted live behavior proof here, then narrow or close the overlapping work in the broader draft.

recommendation.title: Consolidate into the broader PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795 as the canonical branch and preserve any useful focused cases from this PR there.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the broader active branch implementing the same invariant across the helper, providers, and fresh-result boundary.
